notices.description:
The Department of Homeless Services  is seeking appropriately qualified contractors/vendors to contract for the provision of shelter services for families with children, adult families, and single adults who are temporarily housed in DHS contracted commercial hotels. The selected vendors will provide services as outlined in this RFP to assist clients with their daily needs and to help them move out of the shelter system as quickly as possible.

The mission of DHS is to prevent homelessness when possible and to provide short-term emergency shelter for individuals and families who have no other housing options available. DHS primarily meets this goal by providing services to clients in long-term contracted purpose-built shelters throughout the City. When there are not enough available shelter beds and units in traditional shelters, DHS temporarily uses commercial hotels to house clients while they transition to permanent housing.  

Over the last 15 years, DHS has faced numerous crises which have forced DHS to rely on commercial hotels to temporarily house clients. Long term DHS is committed to phasing out the use of commercial hotels.  However, until such time that DH…
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services awarded Neighbors 4 Neighbors Incorporated a $40,281,375 contract, selected from competing proposals, to provide shelter services for families, adult families and single adults housed in city-contracted commercial hotels.

notices.short_title: Ground leasing, rehabilitating, and operating Building 324 and/or Building 330 on Governors Island
notices.description: Governors Island Corporation d/b/a The Trust for Governors Island (the Trust) invites interested parties (Respondents or Respondent Teams) to submit expressions of interest in ground leasing, rehabilitating, and operating Building 324 and/or Building 330 on Governors Island (together, the Buildings). Through this RFEI, the Trust is seeking creative ideas from prospective partners interested in revitalizing these neighboring historic assets, bringing them back into active, year-round use.
notices.plain: The Trust for Governors Island, a city-affiliated corporation, is seeking expressions of interest from prospective partners to lease, rehabilitate and operate Buildings 324 and/or 330 on Governors Island, with responses due Oct. 26, 2026.

notices.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Middle
notices.description: COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Inwood Community Services Inc. a $7.9 million contract, chosen from competing proposals within a pre-qualified list, to run COMPASS after-school, summer and holiday programs for middle school students in public schools.

notices.description:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, PURSUANT TO LAW, that the following proposed revocable consent has been scheduled for a public hearing by the New York City Department of Transportation. A draft copy of the revocable consent agreement(s) may be obtained at no cost by submitting a request at diningoutnyc.info/requestcopy

The public hearing will be held remotely via Zoom, commencing on August 13th, 2026, at 11:00 am, in the matter of a proposed revocable consent authorizing the following:

  1. Cien Fuegos LLC to maintain, operate, and use a roadway cafe for a term of four years adjacent to 96 Avenue A in the Borough of Manhattan

  2. Chama Mama At 113 Franklin LLC to maintain, operate, and use a roadway cafe for a term of four years adjacent to 113 Franklin Street in the Borough of Brooklyn

  3. Rich Mhasarn INC to maintain, operate, and use a roadway cafe for a term of four years adjacent to 131 Grand St in the Borough of Brooklyn.
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation will hold a remote Zoom hearing at 11 a.m. Aug. 13, 2026, on proposed four-year revocable consents letting three businesses operate roadway cafes outside their Manhattan and Brooklyn addresses.
